items.docs:

info.name: Get the bulk user operation status.

params.name: key
params.description: Key of the operation that was obtained during submitting bulk operation.

items.docs:
Returns an operations status object that contains the overall status of the bulk operation.
If the bulk operation has a Finished or FinishedWithError status,
the result of each and every item in the list is returned as well.
If the bulk operation has a Pending or Processing status, only the overall status is returned.
            
API Client needs the User management > Manage users permission.

info.name: Returns the list of application roles associated with a user.

params.name: key
params.description: User key.

params.name: nameContains
params.description: Filters application roles by name.

params.name: assetKey
params.description: Only returns application roles for the specified asset. Mutually exclusive with `assetKeys`.

params.name: assetKeys
params.description: Only returns application roles for any of the specified assets. Comma-separated list of asset keys. Mutually exclusive with `assetKey`.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: Only returns application roles in the specified environment (stage). Mutually exclusive with `environmentKeys`.

params.name: environmentKeys
params.description: Only returns application roles in any of the specified environments (stages). Mutually exclusive with `environmentKey`.

params.name: portfolioKeys
params.description: Only returns application roles in the environments belonging to any of the specified portfolios.

params.name: groupKeys
params.description: Only returns application roles inherited from the specified groups.

params.name: applicationRoleKeys
params.description: Only returns the application roles matching any of the specified keys. Comma-separated list of application role keys.

params.name: sort
params.description: Used for sorting the list. Ascending by default. Prepend a hyphen, "-", to get a descending sort, for example "-name". Default: name. Allowed: name, environmentKey or assetKey.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. Allowed values: 1 to 100 Default value: 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the first result returned. Default value: 0.

params.name: assignmentSources
params.description: Filters by assignment source. Repeatable. Allowed: Direct, GroupAssigned, GroupMapped. Empty or omitted defaults to Direct. The IsDirectlyAssigned flag and AssignedGroups list on each returned role reflect only the selected sources.

items.docs:
Returns a list of application roles associated with a user that match the specified filters. Use query parameters to refine the search.

API Client needs the **User management > View end users** permission.

info.name: Returns the list of organization roles associated with a user.

params.name: key
params.description: User key.

params.name: scopes
params.description: Optional. Comma-separated. `Organization` returns roles assigned in Organization scope; `Asset` returns roles assigned in Asset scope. Both together (or omitted) returns all.

params.name: assetKeys
params.description: Optional. Comma-separated list of asset keys. Only returns organization roles assigned in Asset scope for any of the specified assets.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results returned. The value must be within 1 - 100 (both inclusive). The default value is 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Starting point or position of the first result returned. The default value is 0.

items.docs:
Returns the list of organization roles associated with a user.
If the authenticated user is requesting their own roles, no permission is required.

API Client needs the **User management > View members** or **User management > Manage users** permissions.

params.description: Organization role key.

info.name: Returns the user count based on specified conditions.

params.name: domains
params.description: Only counts users with the specified domains.

params.name: status
params.description: Only counts users with the specified status.

params.name: hasOrganizationRoles
params.description: When set to true, only counts users that have at least one organization role. Default is false.

params.name: hasApplicationRoles
params.description: When set to true, only counts users that have at least one application role. Default is false.

params.name: environmentKeys
params.description: Only counts users that have roles in any of the specified environments (stages).

params.name: portfolioKeys
params.description: Only counts users that have roles in any of the specified portfolios.

params.name: loggedInEnvironmentKeys
params.description: Only counts users that have logged in to any of the specified environments (stages). When combined with last login date filters, the date range applies to the per-environment login timestamp.

params.name: loggedInPortfolioKeys
params.description: Only counts users that have logged in to any environment in the specified portfolios. When combined with last login date filters, the date range applies to the per-environment login timestamp.

params.name: lastLoginAtSince
params.description: Only counts users whose last login occurred on or after the specified date and time. Applies to the top-level last login unless logged-in environment or portfolio filters are specified.

params.name: lastLoginAtTo
params.description: Only counts users whose last login occurred before or on the specified date and time. Applies to the top-level last login unless logged-in environment or portfolio filters are specified.

items.docs:
Returns the user count that match the specified filters. Use query parameters to refine the search.

info.name: Returns the list of users based on specified conditions.

params.name: nameOrEmailContains
params.description:
Filters users by name or email address. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`

params.name: nameOrEmailOrUsernameContains
params.description:
Filters users by name or email address or username. Parameter value must be URL-encoded (percent-encoding) to ensure it's correctly interpreted by the server. Example: Searching for an email with a +
            
 Incorrect: .../users?email=`john+doe@example.com`.
            
 Correct: .../users?email=`john%2Bdoe@example.com`

params.name: userKeys
params.description: Only returns users that match the specified keys. For more than one key, separates the keys with a comma. Allows up to 20 user keys.

params.name: assetKey
params.description: Only returns users that have roles for the specified Asset.

params.name: status
params.description: Only returns users with the specified status.

params.name: lastLoginAtSince
params.description: Only returns users whose last login occurred on or after the specified date and time.

params.name: lastLoginAtTo
params.description: Only returns users whose last login occurred before or on the specified date and time.

params.name: hasOrganizationRoles
params.description: When set to true, only returns users that have at least one organization role. Default is false.

params.name: hasApplicationRoles
params.description: When set to true, only returns users that have at least one application role. Default is false.

params.name: sort
params.description: Used for sorting the list. Ascending by default. Prepend a hyphen, "-", to get a descending sort, for example "-name". Default: name. Allowed: key, name, email, status, lastLoginAt.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: Only returns users that have roles in the specified environment (stage). Mutually exclusive with `environmentKeys`.

params.name: environmentKeys
params.description: Only returns users that have roles in any of the specified environments (stages). Comma-separated list of environment keys. Mutually exclusive with `environmentKey`.

params.name: portfolioKeys
params.description: Only returns users that have roles in any of the specified portfolios.

params.name: domains
params.description: Only returns users with the specified domains.

params.name: loggedInEnvironmentKeys
params.description: Only returns users that have logged in to any of the specified environments (stages). When combined with last login date filters, the date range applies to the per-environment login timestamp.

params.name: loggedInPortfolioKeys
params.description: Only returns users that have logged in to any environment in the specified portfolios. When combined with last login date filters, the date range applies to the per-environment login timestamp.

info.name: Returns a list of groups associated with a user.

params.description: The user key.

params.description: Filters groups by name.

params.description: Filters groups by asset key.

params.name: environmentKey
params.description: Filters groups by environment key (stage). Mutually exclusive with `environmentKeys`.
